title: Protein Supplement Ideas
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml:
GOAL

at least 12gms Pro

less than or equal to 8-10gm Net Carbs

Shakes:

  • JourneyLite Fast Track shakes (Dr. Curry’s brand)
  • Atkins
  • Low Carb Slim Fast
  • Premier Nutrition Shakes (Sam’s and Costco)
  • EAS Myoplex Lite
  • Muscle Milk Lite
  • Pure Protein (pre-made and powders)

Bars:

  • JourneyLite Fast Track Protein Bars (Dr. Curry’s brand)
  • Atkins Bars
  • South Beach Bars
  • Supreme Protein Bars
  • Pure Protein Bars
  • Nature Valley Protein Granola Bar
  • EAS AdvantEDGE—Carb Control
  • Kellogg’s Fiber Plus Protein bar
  • Power Crunch Protein Bars
  • Quest Bars (GNC only)
